"D" Div: Det: Office
File No. C.S.189
20/11/31

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
November 10th, 1931.

D. C. (Crime),

A/C.D.S. 185 and C.D.C.186, Harbin Road.

Sir,

There is nothing can be found to justify the allegations
in the attached. I have interviewed both men and they,
naturally, deny such "Squeeze" habits.

Both came from Hongkew to the Crime Branch two years ago
(1-10-29) and A/C.D.S. 185 was re-instated in his rank on
20-10-31.

Both had Section 1 prior to re-instatement in rank of
A/C.D.S. 185 and used to patrol the Section together. This
Section encloses an area bounded by Mukden, Harbin and
Kashing Roads. In their patrolling they have had occasion
to caution licensed premises (teashops) re allowing "Mo-Tsiang"
on the premises. The licensee of one of these teashops
is a partner in a Kompo theatre called the "Yangchow Nyung
Wo Tai", O.O.L. (Urga Road) and it is possible the allega-
tions originated from some such source.

I have cautioned both to be careful of their conduct
in future.

（签名）
D.D.O. "D" Division.

（左侧手写批注：）
M Ferr
11/11

“D”分区：侦探处办公室
档案号 C.S.189
31年11月20日

（刑事侦缉处）办公室备忘录
1931年11月10日。

致 犯罪股副督察长，

关于代理首席侦探巡长185号和首席侦探巡长186号，哈尔滨路。

先生，

查无实据可证实附件中的指控。我已分别约谈该二人，他们自然否认有此类“敲竹杠”的恶习。

两人均于两年前（1929年10月1日）从虹口调至犯罪股，代理首席侦探巡长185号已于1931年10月20日复职原衔。

在代理首席侦探巡长185号复职之前，两人均在第一警区任职，并曾共同在该警区巡逻。该警区范围由沈阳路、哈尔滨路和嘉兴路所围成。在巡逻过程中，他们曾就持牌场所（茶楼）允许“摸将”（麻将）一事发出警告。其中一家茶楼的老板是位于欧嘉路（Urga Road）的一家名为“扬州新舞台”的坤班剧院的合伙人，指控有可能源自此类来源。

我已告诫两人在今后务必注意其行为举止。

（签名）
“D”分区副分区巡官。

（左侧手写批注：）
M Ferr
11/11

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No. +
Harbin Road Station,
Date 6-11- 1931

Subject (in full) Attached anonymous letter.

Made by D.S. Black. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
I beg to report that the two men mentioned in the letter
are evidently A/C.D.S. 125 Tsou Kwei Yung and C.D.C. 183 Lien
Su Hyuin.
Discreet enquiries re the allegations have been made in
this district from shop-keepers, etc., but nothing that would
verify them has been discovered. The men themselves have been
questioned, but deny that they have demanded money in any way
from any one, further, no reports of this kind have been received
at the station.
I have had personal experience of these two men since
their transfer to the Crime Branch and they have never given
me cause to suspect that they are in any way engaged in this
kind of work; while not being brilliant they have at least been
industrious in their work.
I have been in communication with D.S.I. Bennett and he
also has the same opinion of the men.

D. S. Black.
D. S.

D. D. O. "D".

表格第2号
G. 21,500-7-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案号 +
哈尔滨路捕房，
日期 1931年11月6日

事由（全称） 附匿名信一件。

呈报人 侦探警佐 Black。转呈人 [签名]

先生，
谨此报告，信中提及的两人显然为代理首席侦探巡长125号邹桂荣（Tsou Kwei Yung）和首席侦探巡长183号连瑞贤（Lien Su Hyuin）。
本区已就指控内容向店主等人进行了 discreet enquiries（谨慎查访），但未发现任何可予以证实的情况。经讯问当事人，他们否认曾以任何方式向任何人勒索钱财；此外，捕房也未收到过此类报案。
自这两人调至犯罪股以来，我对他们有亲身了解，他们从未让我有任何理由怀疑其参与此类勾当；虽非才智出众，但至少工作勤勉。
我曾与侦探督察 Bennett 沟通，他对这两人的看法也与我相同。

侦探警佐 Black。
侦探警佐。

“D”分区副分区巡官。

Shanghai 29/10/31
The Commissioner of Police.
Central Police Station
Local.

Dear Sir:- I am taking the
liberty of reporting to you that
Chinese Detective. Liu Tse Shoonf
(劉世勳) and Chow Kae Vung
(周凱文) of Harbin Road Station
have been creating a nuisance
around that quarter, for some
time, forcing Bribes practically
from every stores & shops four to
five times a month, causing
various trouble among the shop-
keepers, even so far as Murders,
would take place should you
not put this matter to a stop.
immediately.
I am writing those few
lines for the sake of all the
pages.zh:
上海 31年10月29日
警察总监。
中央捕房
本地。

尊敬的先生：——我冒昧
向您报告，哈尔滨路捕房的
华籍侦探 刘世勋
(劉世勳) 和 周凯文
(周凱文)
一段时间以来一直在该区域
制造滋扰，几乎每月四到五次
向每家商店强行索取贿赂，
给店主们造成各种麻烦，
如果您不立即制止此事，
甚至可能发生谋杀案。
我写这几行字是为了所有

pages.en:
( 2 )

residents, shops - storekeepers
around that quarter. Peace & Safety
from these two Chinese Detectives.
I shall be very much
appreciated if you will take
immediate steps, preventing
further trouble.
Thanking you in advance.
I am,
Yours truly
A. Resident

D. S.
It would be better if
you'd transfer them to some other
station.

( 2 )

该区域的居民、商店店主的
安宁与安全，免受这两名
华籍侦探之害。
若您能采取
即时措施，防止
进一步滋扰，我将
不胜感激。
预先致谢。
此致
敬礼
一位居民

侦探警佐。
最好将他们
调往其他捕房。
